title: Freight Shipping Options and Delivery Windows
text:
# Freight Shipping Options and Delivery Windows

This article describes the freight shipping and delivery tiers Grassroots Furniture offers to residential and commercial addresses in the continental United States and Canada. All shipments are governed by policy POL-SHIP-01 and reviewed biannually.

## Services and delivery windows

Because solid wood dining tables and upholstered sofas cannot travel via parcel post, Grassroots Furniture ships via specialized freight carriers. Orders leave our Portland and High Point workshops within their scheduled dispatch windows.

- Standard Curbside: 5 to 10 business days after dispatch. The freight carrier unloads boxed crates onto your driveway or curb.
- Threshold Delivery: 4 to 8 business days. The carrier brings boxed pieces just inside your front door, garage, or dry exterior entryway.
- White Glove Delivery: 3 to 7 business days. Delivery specialists bring items into your room-of-choice, unpack, assemble, and remove all debris.

Monday through Friday are standard freight delivery days. Weekend delivery is available in select metropolitan areas for White Glove service only.

## Fees

Standard Curbside delivery is free on all orders of 1,500 dollars or more. Below that threshold, curbside delivery carries a flat rate of 99 dollars. Threshold delivery is 149 dollars. White Glove Delivery is 249 dollars, and neither service tier is ever free regardless of order total, unless granted via Summit Tier loyalty status.

## Surcharges

Remote locations and islands carry a freight surcharge of 75 dollars per order. Canadian destinations carry a cross-border customs handling fee of 120 dollars per order.

Solid hardwood dining tables exceeding 84 inches and stone-top credenzas are flagged with an Oversized Freight badge on the product page. These pieces require special two-person handling and carry an additional 50 dollar heavy-timber handling surcharge.

## Delivery restrictions

Our freight carriers cannot deliver to post office boxes or military APO addresses. Freight trucks require a minimum clearance of 13 feet and cannot access dead-end alleys or steep unpaved mountain switchbacks without prior arrangements.

title: Tracking a Furniture Shipment
text:
# Tracking a Furniture Shipment

Every Grassroots Furniture order dispatched through our freight carrier network receives a unique bill of lading tracking number as soon as crates leave our staging docks.

## Where your tracking number comes from

Grassroots Furniture tracking numbers always begin with the prefix GFT- followed by ten digits, for example GFT-5507905865. This is the master reference number to quote when contacting concierge support.

You will receive an automated dispatch email with your GFT- tracking number within two hours of freight pickup. For multi-piece sectional orders that ship in separate crates, each crate is linked under this primary tracking reference.

## Reading a tracking status

- Label Created: The bill of lading has been issued, and crates are staged in our dispatch bay awaiting freight carrier pickup.
- In Transit: The freight carrier has scanned the shipment onto a long-haul line-haul trailer.
- Out for Delivery: The shipment has arrived at your regional delivery terminal and is on a local box truck with an active dispatch manifest.
- Delivered: The carrier has recorded successful delivery, obtained a recipient signature, and documented location.
- Exception: The carrier encountered an access delay, such as a gated entry code issue or weather disruption. Report any exception lasting over 48 hours to support.

## When tracking has not moved

Freight line-haul trailers often travel across multiple states between major interchange hubs without intermediate scans. Allow up to three business days without a scan update before requesting an inquiry. After three days, concierge support will initiate an active freight dock trace.

title: Damaged in Transit, Lost, or Missing Furniture Deliveries
text:
# Damaged in Transit, Lost, or Missing Furniture Deliveries

Handcrafted solid wood furniture requires rigorous protection, but transit hazards occasionally cause damage. This article explains how to inspect and report issues.

## Marked delivered but not received

If your tracking status updates to Delivered but you have not received your furniture, check with household members, building concierge, or your garage. Delivery drivers often place threshold shipments inside covered side porches.

If your furniture has not appeared within 24 hours of the delivery notification, contact our support team immediately to open an unlocated freight inquiry.

## Inspecting and reporting damage

When your furniture arrives, inspect the outer crating and the pieces before signing the driver's delivery manifest. Note any visible gouges, torn cartons, or broken timber directly on the delivery receipt.

If damage is discovered, notify concierge support within 24 hours of delivery. Claims are filed using form LP-14, available on your online order dashboard. You must attach clear photographs showing the shipping label, packaging condition, and the damage to the furniture piece.

## Resolution and replacement

Claims submitted on form LP-14 are reviewed within two business days. Grassroots Furniture will dispatch an on-site furniture repair specialist for superficial scratches, or schedule an expedited replacement build for structural wood fractures at zero cost.

title: Return Policy
text:
# Return Policy

Grassroots Furniture wants you to love your handcrafted furniture in your own home. We offer a comprehensive in-home trial period for standard catalog items.

## Return window and eligibility

You may return eligible standard furniture pieces within 60 days of delivery. The item must be in clean, like-new condition, free of pet hair, liquid damage, smoke odor, and finish abrasions.

To be eligible, pieces must have their original structural integrity intact and not have been modified, refinished, or treated with aftermarket sealants.

## Excluded items and restocking terms

Custom bespoke commissions (pieces built to custom non-catalog dimensions, or upholstered in customer's own material) are final sale and cannot be returned.

Under our current return policy, there is no restocking fee on standard catalog returns initiated within the 60-day window. Historical policies requiring restocking deductions no longer apply.

## Return freight costs

While there is no restocking fee, returned freight requires specialized transport. Standard freight return shipping deductions apply as detailed in our return fees schedule, unless the return is due to manufacturer defect.

title: How to Start a Return and Schedule Freight Pickup
text:
# How to Start a Return and Schedule Freight Pickup

Coordinating the return of large dining tables, sofas, and solid wood case goods requires scheduled carrier coordination.

## Submitting your return request

To begin, log into your account at grassrootsfurniture.com, navigate to your order history, and select Request Return.

Our logistics team will verify eligibility and issue a Return Merchandise Authorization within 24 business hours. You will receive an email confirmation with your return authorization number and packaging guidelines.

## Preparing the furniture and pickup window

Please protect the furniture with blanket wrap or original corrugated pads. Detach table legs if they were modularly installed, and place all hardware in a sealed bag taped securely under the tabletop.

Our freight partner will contact you via text and email to schedule a 4-hour pickup window. An adult must be present at the premises during pickup to sign the carrier transfer bill of lading.

title: Return Shipping Costs, Restocking Fees, and Refund Timing
text:
# Return Shipping Costs, Restocking Fees, and Refund Timing

This guide details freight deductions and processing timelines for authorized Grassroots Furniture returns.

## Return shipping charges

Because freight transport is costly, returns of standard catalog furniture incur a subsidized flat return freight deduction:
- Dining tables, sofas, sectionals, and credenzas: flat freight return deduction of $99 per piece.
- Dining chairs, barstools, and small side tables: flat freight deduction of $35 per piece.

If an item is returned due to a confirmed manufacturing flaw or transit damage, all freight fees are waived entirely.

## Refund processing and inspection

Once your return arrives at our regional restoration workshop, our timber craftsmen inspect the piece within 3 business days.

Approved refunds are credited to your original payment method within 5 to 7 business days following inspection. Banks typically post the credit to your statement within 1 to 3 billing cycles.

title: Canadian / International Furniture Deliveries and Customs
text:
# Canadian / International Furniture Deliveries and Customs

Grassroots Furniture delivers throughout Canadian provinces via certified bonded cross-border freight partners.

## Canadian delivery procedures

Canadian orders include customs clearance, provincial GST/HST, and cross-border freight handling calculated at checkout. Delivery timelines range from 8 to 14 business days following workshop dispatch.

Curbside and Threshold deliveries are available in all major Canadian metropolitan corridors including Toronto, Montreal, Calgary, and Vancouver.

## International return procedures

Canadian customers are entitled to our standard 60-day return window. However, all returned international items must be routed back through our Niagara Falls transit depot.

Cross-border freight fees, customs brokerage, and duties paid to the CBSA cannot be refunded by Grassroots Furniture. Customers are responsible for the return transit cost to the Niagara Falls transit depot.

title: Furniture Exchanges and Fabric Reselection
text:
# Furniture Exchanges and Fabric Reselection

We understand that timber tones and upholstery hues can appear different under residential lighting compared to a digital screen.

## Exchange conditions

You may request an exchange for an alternate wood finish (e.g., Walnut to White Oak) or a different upholstery fabric within the same 60-day window from initial delivery.

Items submitted for exchange must be in pristine condition. If you choose a replacement item of greater value, you pay the price difference. If the replacement is priced lower, we issue a prompt refund for the balance.

## Consolidated exchange delivery

When feasible, our freight carrier will coordinate a simultaneous delivery and pickup. The carrier unloads and inspects the new piece while simultaneously loading the piece being exchanged, minimizing handling.

title: The Grassroots Craftsmanship Guarantee
text:
# The Grassroots Craftsmanship Guarantee

Every piece of Grassroots Furniture is built with traditional mortise-and-tenon joinery, kiln-dried domestic hardwoods, and durable organic finishes.

## Scope of structural warranty

We back our craftsmanship with a comprehensive 10-year structural warranty on all solid wood frames, internal steel supports, and artisan joinery under normal residential indoor use.

If a joint separates, a table leg splits, or a frame cracks under normal living room or dining room use within ten years, Grassroots Furniture will repair or replace the piece at our discretion.

## Exclusions and cosmetic care

Upholstery fabrics, stitching seams, and cushion foam cores are warrantied for 3 years against abnormal sagging.

The guarantee does not cover damage caused by commercial abuse, outdoor exposure of indoor furniture, water submersion, or drastic humidity swings below 25% or above 70%.

title: Filing a Furniture Warranty Claim
text:
# Filing a Furniture Warranty Claim

Our dedicated warranty concierge team is committed to keeping your handcrafted pieces in service for decades.

## How to submit your claim

To initiate a warranty assessment, download and complete form WC-22 from our online customer portal.

Submit the form along with:
- Your Grassroots Furniture order number (e.g., GF-40318).
- A photo of the burned woodmaker's brand or product serial stamp under the piece.
- Wide-angle and close-up photographs showing the structural failure or seam issue.

## Review timeline and remedies

Our master craftsmen review all submitted claims within 3 business days. If approved, we will arrange for a qualified local furniture conservator to visit your home, or transport the item to our workshop for rebuild.

title: Current Safety & Recall Notices
text:
# Current Safety & Recall Notices

Grassroots Furniture adheres strictly to the highest safety standards, including ASTM F2057 anti-tip safety standards for bedroom case goods.

## Active hardware recall

In voluntary partnership with the CPSC, Grassroots Furniture has issued a safety recall notice for wall-anchor bracket kit TH45-B distributed with tall dressers and bookshelves between March 2024 and February 2025.

The zinc alloy cast in bracket kit TH45-B was found to exhibit fatigue under shear load in rare stress environments.

## Free replacement reinforcement kits

All owners of recalled units are entitled to receive an upgraded heavy-gauge steel reinforcement bracket kit free of charge. Contact safety@grassrootsfurniture.com with model code TH45-B to receive your kit.

title: Payment Methods We Accept
text:
# Payment Methods We Accept

We offer secure, transparent payment options for online, showroom, and custom furniture orders.

## Accepted payment types

Grassroots Furniture accepts Visa, MasterCard, American Express, and Discover credit and debit cards. We also support Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Shop Pay for rapid checkout.

For commercial interior architecture projects and orders exceeding 5,000 dollars, we accept bank wire transfers and electronic ACH transfers with a 2% settlement discount.

## Financing and deferred payments

We partner with Affirm to provide transparent monthly payment financing with 0% APR terms available over 6, 12, or 24 months for qualified buyers. We do not accept cryptocurrency or COD orders.

title: Custom Order Deposits, Authorization Holds, and Billing
text:
# Custom Order Deposits, Authorization Holds, and Billing

Understanding our authorization and billing cycles helps avoid unexpected banking alerts during checkout.

## Authorization holds during checkout

When you place an order, your financial institution places a temporary pre-authorization hold on your funds. If you add fabric swatch samples or modify your order during checkout, you can see three holds temporarily reflected on your banking application.

These temporary holds automatically drop off within 3 to 5 business days according to your bank's schedule.

## Final payment capture

Full payment is captured when timber grading is complete and the raw lumber is pulled for sawing at our mill. You will receive an invoice detailing your wood species, dimensions, and estimated build completion.

title: Disputed Charges and Cancellation Requests
text:
# Disputed Charges and Cancellation Requests

If an unfamiliar charge appears from Grassroots Furniture, please contact our billing concierge before initiating a formal bank dispute.

## Dispute case tracking

When a bank charge dispute is received, it is assigned a tracking case with code prefix BD-, such as BD-9140.

Our accounting department reviews disputed charges within 48 hours. Most discrepancies result from family members ordering swatch kits or shipping surcharge adjustments.

## Impact of premature disputes

Filing a formal charge dispute automatically halts timber cutting and places active freight shipments on hold. Contacting concierge support directly resolves billing questions much faster than banking chargeback channels.

title: Trade Discount Codes and Promotional Stacking Rules
text:
# Trade Discount Codes and Promotional Stacking Rules

Grassroots Furniture supports certified architects, interior decorators, and commercial general contractors through our Trade Program.

## Program discounts and credentials

Verified trade partners receive a 20% discount on catalog collections and 15% on bespoke dining tables. To qualify, submit your business license, resale certificate, and ASID or AIA credential on our trade portal.

## Discount stacking limitations

Only one promotional discount or trade code can be applied per order. Promotional codes cannot be combined with showroom floor sample sale pricing or clearance outlet pieces. Trade discounts do not apply to White Glove delivery surcharges.

title: Grassroots Club Rewards Program Tiers
text:
# Grassroots Club Rewards Program Tiers

Our loyalty program rewards homeowners, designers, and enthusiasts who furnish their spaces with our handcrafted timber furniture.

## Tier progression

- Timber Tier: Spend $0 to $2,500. Earn 1 point per dollar spent. Includes access to seasonal wood sales and free fabric swatch bundles.
- Artisan Tier: Spend $2,501 to $7,500. Earn 1.5 points per dollar. Includes free Threshold delivery upgrades and priority workshop build scheduling.
- Summit Tier: Spend $7,501 or more. Earn 2 points per dollar spent. Includes complimentary White Glove delivery on all orders and a dedicated woodcraft concierge.

## Point redemption

Points can be redeemed at checkout: 100 points redeem for 5 dollars toward any future furniture purchase or wood care kit. Points remain active for 24 months from last purchase.

title: Gift Cards and Swatch Credit Certificates
text:
# Gift Cards and Swatch Credit Certificates

Grassroots Furniture digital and physical gift cards make timeless wedding, housewarming, and anniversary gifts.

## Gift card rules and policies

Gift cards never expire and carry no dormancy or maintenance fee. They can be redeemed online or at any Grassroots Furniture workshop showroom.

A physical gift card cannot be reissued if lost, because we cannot prove who holds it. Keep your gift card number secure.

## Fabric swatch credit program

Ordering a curated fabric and wood swatch box costs 25 dollars, but includes a 25 dollar promotional credit code valid on any furniture purchase over 500 dollars placed within 12 months.

title: Creating and Managing Your Grassroots Account
text:
# Creating and Managing Your Grassroots Account

An online account lets you save room dimensions, view carpentry build photos, and manage delivery windows.

## Account registration and security

When registering, our system sends an email verification link. The link is valid for 24 hours and can be regenerated at any time from the sign-in modal.

Passwords must be At least 12 characters, and not one of the passwords on our blocked-passwords list. Passwords must contain a combination of letters, numerals, and symbols.

## Profile settings and address book

You can maintain multiple shipping profiles in your address book, making it easy to ship dining chairs to a primary residence and patio benches to a summer home.

title: Suspicious Account Activity and Security Verification
text:
# Suspicious Account Activity and Security Verification

We employ automated risk monitoring to protect your saved payment profiles, trade discount credentials, and shipping addresses.

## Automated security locks

If five consecutive incorrect password attempts are detected, our security firewall will lock the account for 30 minutes to safeguard against credential stuffing.

You will receive an automated security alert with an instant one-time verification passcode to unlock your account immediately without waiting for the 30-minute timer.

## Unauthorized changes

If you receive notification of an email or shipping address update that you did not initiate, contact security@grassrootsfurniture.com immediately to suspend pending order shipments.

title: Resetting Your Account Password
text:
# Resetting Your Account Password

If you cannot access your account or need to rotate credentials, follow our automated password reset protocol.

## Step-by-step reset instructions

1. Navigate to the sign-in modal and click 'Forgot your password?'.
2. Enter the email address associated with your Grassroots Furniture account.
3. Check your inbox for a secure token link from accounts@grassrootsfurniture.com.

## Troubleshooting error codes

If the reset link fails and displays error E-118, it means the token has expired due to 15 minutes of inactivity. Simply click 'Resend Password Reset' to obtain a fresh token and complete your update.

title: Privacy, Data Handling, and Showroom Appointments
text:
# Privacy, Data Handling, and Showroom Appointments

Grassroots Furniture values customer trust and adheres to strict privacy and data protection principles.

## Customer data collection

We collect customer names, shipping addresses, telephone numbers, and floor dimensions exclusively to build, freight, and service your furniture. We never sell your personal data or design CAD files to third-party advertisers.

Payment credentials are encrypted and processed through PCI-DSS Level 1 compliant gateways; Grassroots Furniture never stores raw credit card numbers.

## Data access and deletion rights

Under GDPR and CCPA, you have the right to request a complete record of your personal data or request permanent deletion. Email your request to privacy@grassrootsfurniture.com and our compliance team will process it within 30 days.

title: Dining Room Sizing Guide: Table Dimensions and Seating Clearance
text:
# Dining Room Sizing Guide: Table Dimensions and Seating Clearance

Choosing the proper dining table size ensures comfortable ergonomics and fluid circulation in your dining space.

## Clearance recommendations

Always maintain at least 36 to 42 inches between the perimeter of your dining table and surrounding walls or sideboards. This allows diners to pull chairs out smoothly and permits easy walking behind seated guests.

For table length, allocate 24 inches of table width per place setting for standard dining chairs, or 28 inches for wide armchairs.

## Modular dining benches and interchangeable hardware

Our solid oak and walnut dining benches are engineered to tuck completely under matching tables when not in use.

Our bench leg brackets feature interchangeable hardware that connects seamlessly with both 72-inch and 84-inch dining table models, giving you flexibility to rearrange configurations.

title: Solid Hardwood Care: Humidity, Oiling, and Preventing Warping
text:
# Solid Hardwood Care: Humidity, Oiling, and Preventing Warping

Solid timber is an organic material that breathes and interacts dynamically with residential climate conditions.

## Managing humidity and temperature

Maintain residential relative humidity between 35% and 55%. Extreme dry winter air can cause wood to contract and develop micro-checks, while excessive summer humidity can cause drawer binding. Avoid placing tables directly over radiant floor heating ducts or beside wood stoves.

## Oiling schedule and wood conditioner

For oiled timber finishes, apply organic linseed oil conditioner for walnut or white oak once every six months.

Spread a thin coat along the wood grain using a clean lint-free cloth. Allow the natural oils to penetrate for 15 minutes, then buff dry with a clean cotton rag. Do not use aerosol furniture polishes containing silicone.

title: Upholstery Fabric Care: Performance Bouclé, Velvet, and Top-Grain Leather
text:
# Upholstery Fabric Care: Performance Bouclé, Velvet, and Top-Grain Leather

Our upholstered sofas and lounge chairs are tailored with contract-grade textiles and vegetable-tanned Italian leathers.

## Safety and flammability compliance

All Grassroots Furniture upholstery fabrics meet CAL-117-2013 flammability and wear durability standards without the use of added toxic chemical flame retardants.

Our bouclé and velvet fabrics withstand 50,000 double rubs on the Wyzenbeek abrasion scale, ensuring enduring resilience against everyday family living.

## Cleaning and spot treatment

Blot spills immediately with an undyed absorbent cloth; never rub vigorously. For water-based stains on performance bouclé, use lukewarm water and mild dish soap. For leather, wipe monthly with a damp cloth and treat annually with a natural beeswax leather conditioner.

title: Cushion Density, Fill Types, and Foam vs Down Breakdown
text:
# Cushion Density, Fill Types, and Foam vs Down Breakdown

We construct our sofa cushions for the perfect equilibrium of plush lounging and ergonomic posture support.

## Core construction and down wraps

Our standard sofa cushions feature a high-resiliency 2.8 lb/cu.ft polyurethane foam core encased in a baffled, cruelty-free duck feather and microfiber duvet. This prevents down migration while providing a tailored profile.

Our multi-tier cushion cores withstand a 10 metre column pressure rating in standardized load tests, ensuring cushions spring back to shape without permanent hollows.

## Cushion maintenance and fluffing

To maintain even wear, rotate and flip seat and back cushions every two months. Give cushions a gentle pat along the edges weekly to redistributing down loft.

title: Showroom Pickup and Warehouse Depot Returns
text:
# Showroom Pickup and Warehouse Depot Returns

Customers residing near our workshop hubs in Oregon and North Carolina can opt for direct warehouse pickup to save freight time.

## Warehouse pickup guidelines

When your furniture is marked Complete, our logistics depot will notify you to schedule a pickup appointment.

Ensure your vehicle is capable of carrying crated furniture. Bring ratcheting tie-down straps and moving blankets. Our warehouse team will forklift crates onto your open trailer or flatbed, but customers are responsible for securing the load.

## Depot return drop-offs

Authorized returns can be dropped off directly at our regional depots with prior RMA approval. Dropping off an authorized return at a depot waives the standard $99 freight return fee.

title: Custom Built-to-Order Lead Times and Preorders
text:
# Custom Built-to-Order Lead Times and Preorders

Because our furniture is handcrafted from sustainable lumber rather than mass-produced in offshore factories, orders require dedicated production lead times.

## Production timelines

- In-Stock Catalog Pieces: Dispatch within 3 to 5 business days.
- Made-to-Order Dining Sets and Sofas: 4 to 8 weeks carpentry build time.
- Custom Architectural Millwork and Bespoke Dimensions: 8 to 12 weeks.

## Preorder billing and delay guarantees

You are not charged for a backordered item until it ships from our workshop. Preorders require only an authorization hold at placement.

If an estimated completion date slips by more than 30 days from the estimate shown when you ordered, we email you a one-click cancellation link allowing you to receive an immediate 100% refund.

title: Contacting Grassroots Furniture Concierge Support
text:
# Contacting Grassroots Furniture Concierge Support

Our knowledgeable concierge support team is based directly inside our main workshop and can assist with orders, dimensions, and wood care.

## Contact methods and hours

- Phone: 1-800-555-WOOD (Monday - Friday, 8:00 AM - 6:00 PM EST).
- Email: concierge@grassrootsfurniture.com (Response within one business day).
- Live Chat: Accessible via our website during normal business hours.

## Order inquiries

When calling or writing about an existing order, please have your Grassroots Furniture order number ready (e.g., GF-40318). For transit damage, please have your GFT- tracking number and photos available.

title: Price Match and Showroom Floor Model Adjustments
text:
# Price Match and Showroom Floor Model Adjustments

We believe in honest, fair pricing and offer a 14-day price protection policy on all standard catalog pieces.

## Price protection policy

If an item you purchased at regular price goes on sale within 14 calendar days of your order date, we will refund the price difference back to your original payment method.

Please note that price adjustment is not automatic; you must contact concierge support with your order number during the active promotion to request the adjustment.

## Showroom floor samples

Showroom floor models and sample sale pieces are sold as-is with disclosed minor patina. Price adjustments and catalog promotional codes do not apply to floor samples.

title: Modifying or Cancelling a Made-to-Order Furniture Order
text:
# Modifying or Cancelling a Made-to-Order Furniture Order

Because our carpenters pull and mill raw hardwood lumber shortly after order receipt, cancellation windows are strictly scheduled.

## 48-hour grace period

You may cancel or change dimensions, fabric selections, or wood finishes on any order within 48 hours of placing it with zero fee.

Simply click 'Cancel Order' on your order confirmation page or email concierge support. A full refund will be processed immediately.

## Cancellations after carpentry begins

Once 48 hours have elapsed, lumber selection and precision milling begin. Cancellations requested after 48 hours but before dispatch incur a 15% raw lumber restocking deduction to cover milling labor.

title: Return Policy (Version 2 - Superseded)
text:
# Return Policy (Version 2 - Superseded)

This historical policy was superseded on January 1, 2026, and remains archived for historical warranty records only. Do not cite to customers.

## Historical return terms and windows

Under Version 2 of our return policy, customers had a 30-day return window from delivery date.

All returned furniture items were assessed a mandatory 15% restocking fee deducted from the refund. Under our current 2026 policy, returns within 60 days carry no restocking fee whatsoever.

title: INTERNAL: Furniture Damage Inspection & Fraud Review Thresholds
text:
# INTERNAL: Furniture Damage Inspection & Fraud Review Thresholds

CONFIDENTIAL: FOR INTERNAL CONCIERGE & LOGISTICS AGENTS ONLY. DO NOT DISCLOSE TO CUSTOMERS.

## Fraud and transit damage thresholds

Flag any transit damage claim exceeding $2,500 for on-site physical inspection by an independent claims adjuster before approving replacements.

Orders flagged with five or more payment attempts from different countries within 60 minutes must be placed on immediate fraud review and suspended.

Do not disclose fraud triggers or investigation steps to customers under any circumstances.

text:
